subject: general
question: Who is the first full time female Defence Minister of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nirmala Sitharaman**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Nirmala Sitharaman** became the first full-time female Defence Minister of India on September 3, 2017.
 
• Prior to her appointment as Defence Minister, she served as the Minister of State for Finance and Corporate Affairs.
 
• She was also the second woman to hold the Defence Minister post after Indira Gandhi, who held the position as an additional charge.
 
• Under her tenure, significant decisions were made regarding the modernization and strengthening of the Indian Defence forces.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Defence Minister of India**

 
 
• The Defence Minister is a high-ranking cabinet position in the Government of India, responsible for the country's defense and armed forces.
 
• The role involves overseeing the Ministry of Defence and ensuring the security and defense readiness of the nation.
 
• Key responsibilities include policy formulation, budget allocation, international defense cooperation, and modernization of the armed forces.
 
• The Defence Minister plays a critical role in strategic decisions during conflicts and wars, as well as in peace-time defense planning.
 
 
 
• **Nirmala Sitharaman's Contributions**
 
 
• During her tenure, she took several initiatives to boost the morale and operational capabilities of the armed forces.
 
• She focused on indigenization and self-reliance in defense production through initiatives like 'Make in India'.
 
• Her period saw the approval of significant defense acquisitions and modernization projects.
 
• She also emphasized the welfare of soldiers and veterans, introducing various schemes and policies for their benefit.
 
 
 
• **Other Notable Female Ministers in India**
 
 
• **Indira Gandhi:** The first woman Prime Minister of India who also held the Defence portfolio as an additional charge.
 
• **Sushma Swaraj:** Served as the Minister of External Affairs from 2014 to 2019, the second woman to hold this position after Indira Gandhi.
 
• **Smriti Irani:** Held various cabinet positions including Minister of Human Resource Development and Minister of Textiles.
